exposure: management of obstructed inguinal hernia (conservative followed by surgical)
administration of recombinant activated factor VII concentrate
cohort: A 2-month-old infant with congenital factor VII deficiency presented with obstructed right inguinal hernia.
finding: An infant with congenital factor VII deficiency presenting with obstructed inguinal hernia was successfully managed with conservative treatment followed by herniotomy under cover of recombinant activated factor VII concentrate, without significant bleeding complications.
